description: Closed vocabularies for reviewer findings (#401). A finding carries one `kind:` and one `class:` line. scripts/review-findings-lint.mjs reads this file; extending a vocabulary is a reviewed change to this file, not a reviewer improvisation.

blocker.description: Must be fixed before merge. Requires a `trigger:` line naming a concrete input, state or call sequence reachable in the diff and the wrong outcome it produces.

note.description: Observation without a reachable trigger. Never blocks.

rule-candidate.description: A pattern no configured deterministic tool covers. Filed so a rule can be proposed; never a blocker.

classes.ignored-error-return: A returned error, exit status or rejected promise is dropped.
classes.unclosed-resource: A handle, process, lock, temp file or connection is not released on some path.
classes.style: Formatting, naming or idiom with no behavioral effect.
classes.speculative-no-trigger: "This could break" with no reachable trigger in the diff.
classes.logic: Wrong result on a reachable input or state.
classes.security: Authn/z, injection, secrets, SSRF, unsafe deserialization.
classes.contract-coverage: A sprint-contract criterion has no evidence in the diff.
classes.test-integrity: Removed, skipped or weakened tests; a test that cannot fail.
classes.other: None of the above. Prefer a specific class; recurrence of `other` is itself a signal to extend this list.
